messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++11 code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<perturbed_code_1>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <unordered_set>

using namespace std;

const int MAXN = 1<<20;
const int MOD = 1000000007;

bool bio[MAXN];

int main()
{
	ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
	cin.tie(0);
	
	int p, k, i;
	long long inv;
	long long sol = 1;
	
	cin>>p>>k;
	
	if (k == 0)
	{
		for (i = 1; i < p; ++i)
			sol = (sol * p) % MOD;
		goto end;
	}
	
	for (inv = 1; (inv * k) % p != 1; ++inv);
	
	if (k == 1)
		sol = p;
	
	for (i = 1; i < p; ++i)
	{
		if (!bio[i])
		{
			sol = (sol * p) % MOD;
			
			for (long long j = i; !bio[j]; j = (j * inv) % p)
				bio[j] = true;
		}
	}
	end:
	cout<<sol<<endl;
}

</perturbed_code_1>
